_note: Shortcut keys. Each binding joins a key to an action. A key is one character such as "/" or "?", or a named key (Escape, Enter, Space, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Insert, Delete, Backspace, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, F1 to F12), with optional Ctrl+, Alt+ and Shift+ in front, for example "Ctrl+Shift+P". Shift+ only goes with letters and named keys: write "?" rather than "Shift+/". Actions: "focus-search" (the search box in the vertical menu), "leave-field" (move out of a text box), "page:NAME" (open a page: dashboard, panels, tables, cards, charts, options, jobs, errors, help). Keys without Ctrl or Alt are ignored while you type in a text box, except leave-field. Ctrl+A, C, V, X, Y and Z are kept for editing. Changes apply when the app starts or when the Help page is opened.
